definitions.ask: Should the Preview pane's update diff also hide blank spacer rows, not just the Record Card's Changes section?
definitions.why: Preview shows the same blank rows; create previews already hide blank body lines

definitions.ask: Should the compact Changes section keep added heading rows such as `## Notes`?
definitions.why: One row names the new section and the bullet still fits in the three-row card

choices.label: A first note shows two rows, `## Notes` and the bullet, so the new section is visible
Card shows only note bullets; a newly created section's heading no longer appears
